title: Apple U2 / U3 Ultra-Wideband (UWB) RF Physical Layer & Baseband Specification

rf_phy_architecture.standard_compliance: IEEE 802.15.4z-2020 High Rate Pulse (HRP) UWB PHY
rf_phy_architecture.modulation: BPRF (Base Pulse Repetition Frequency) & HPRF (Higher Pulse Repetition Frequency) with BPM-BPSK

channel_allocations.regulatory_status: Worldwide Authorized (US FCC, EU ETSI, Japan MIC)
Primary High-Band Channel for Apple Nearby Interaction & AirTags

fem_interfaces.txfem: Power Amplifier (PA) front-end switch and pre-driver
fem_interfaces.rxfem: Low-Noise Amplifier (LNA) front-end switch across 3-antenna array
fem_interfaces.lbfem: Internal Loopback Front-End Module for self-calibration

loopback_calibration.purpose: Measures internal transceiver group delay and phase skew at boot, removing hardware circuit delay from spatial ToF calculations.

power_management_and_sar.sar_budget_integration: Dynamic Specific Absorption Rate power capping driven by proximity sensors via devicetree billboard-addr-tx-sar-budget.

registers.name: pa_slice
registers.description: PA output stage transistor slice enable mask (0x000 - 0x3ff)

registers.name: pa_ldo_vtrim
registers.description: Low-dropout regulator voltage trim for PA stages {vtrm0, vtrm1}

registers.name: pa_fb_ratio
registers.description: Feedback attenuation ratio for linearizing high-power pulses

coexisting_radios.mechanism: COEX Watch LTE blanking request / release

multi_radio_coexistence.state_machine: Dynamically halts UWB transmission during Cellular high-power uplink pulses or Wi-Fi beacon reception, preventing LNA desensitization.
